tasks.title: Fix ArchiveScraper CDX bugs — skip header row (i=1) + fix Wayback availability shape
tasks.context: Phase 1 — TikTok Content Agent | Sprint 072 bug fixes. The ArchiveScraper.scrape() method was implemented in Sprint 071 (task 071-02, approved 85/100) but the review identified two high-severity bugs that will cause incorrect results on real API calls: (1) CDX API returns a header row as index 0 — the loop at i=0 processes field names as data, producing a malformed ArchiveResult. (2) Wayback availability API response shape is { archived_snapshots: { closest: { url, timestamp, status } } }, not { closest: { title, year, description } }. Code reads availabilityData.closest which is always undefined, making title/year/description always empty strings. Both bugs were logged in sprint-071.json output.issues array and are now being fixed surgically.

tasks.title: Implement VisionScorer — real Ollama scoring replacing Math.random() stub
tasks.context: Phase 1 — TikTok Content Agent | Vision Scorer Step 2. The VisionScorer scaffold was created in Sprint 071 (task 071-03, approved 87/100) with a stub scoreThumbnails() that returns Math.random() * 100 scores. This task replaces the stub with real Ollama inference. Strategy: (1) Attempt to fetch the image URL and encode as base64 — if successful, call qwen2-vl vision model with the image. (2) If image fetch fails (rate limit, non-image URL, network error), fall back to qwen3:14b text scoring — ask the model to estimate TikTok visual appeal based on the URL and media type. Both paths return a JSON score object. The qwen3:14b model is always loaded (9.3GB, primary workhorse). qwen2-vl is not currently installed — the code must handle its absence gracefully via the text fallback. Node.js built-in fetch is available (Node 18+). No new npm dependencies allowed.

tasks.title: Fix routing JSONL sprint_id — stamp from sprint file path in loadTasks()
tasks.context: Sprint routing JSONL (logs/routing/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl) began generating entries in Sprint 071 after the resolve-route.ts fix. However, all entries show sprint_id: 'unknown'. Root cause: in CodingAgent (line ~1465), the code reads (task as any).sprint_id ?? 'unknown' — but individual task objects in the sprint JSON have no sprint_id field. The fix is to derive the sprint ID from the sprint file path (process.argv[2]) in loadTasks() and stamp it onto each task during normalization. The same derivation pattern is already used at lines 2205-2206 and 2262-2263 for the event bus: process.argv[2].replace(/.*\//, '').replace('.json', ''). This is a 3-line addition to the 2864-line orchestrator — no rewrites.
